entries.name: Two eggs on wholegrain toast with chickpea spread and Corale baked beans
entries.quantity: 2 large eggs, 2 slices wholegrain toast (assumed), ~20 g chickpea spread (assumed), 90 g Corale baked beans
entries.notes: Corale beans scaled from photographed label: 90 g = 72 kcal, 4.1 g protein, 9.7 g carbs, 0.6 g fat, 6.1 g fibre, 3.7 g sugar. Eggs/toast/spread are estimates; toast type and chickpea spread weight not confirmed. Added sugar unknown.

entries.name: Iced protein coffee with almond milk
entries.quantity: 150 mL Inner Goodness Original almond milk (assumed), 1 espresso shot, 1 scoop chocolate whey protein
entries.notes: Standard protein coffee using almond milk instead of full-cream milk; assumes 150 mL almond milk and usual whey scoop. Macro estimates, added sugar not confirmed.

entries.name: One and a half large bananas
entries.quantity: 1 large banana plus half a large banana (~202.5 g edible portion estimated)
entries.notes: Estimated using 135 g edible weight per large banana; naturally occurring fruit sugar, no added sugar.

entries.name: Man Shake with mixed fruit, oats, almond milk and Greek style yoghurt
entries.quantity: 1 standard Man Shake serving (assumed), 80 g frozen mixed fruit, 25 g rolled oats, 120 mL almond milk, 50 g Lyttos Greek Style natural yoghurt
entries.notes: Man Shake estimated at 200 kcal and 30 g protein for a standard serving; exact powder quantity/flavour and nutrition label not supplied. Fruit mix unspecified. Lyttos yoghurt label 128 kcal, 4.9 g protein, 9.7 g fat, 5.5 g carbs, 4.5 g sugar per 100 g. Carbs and fat estimated; fibre and sugar unknown until shake powder and fruit nutrition confirmed.
